fullContent:
Sudarshan Churna – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ayurved Sar Sangrah, Churna Prakarna 
 Introduction 
 Sudarshan churna is an Ayurvedic formulation. It aids in treating fever due to various reasons. It induces gentle perspiration, which helps reduce body temperature naturally. With its diuretic properties, it also promotes increased urination, aiding the elimination of toxins from the body. Traditionally used for treating different types of fevers, including malaria.This formulation helps in removing toxic substances from the blood. Sudarshan churna helps in enhancing appetite and digestion. It also protects the body against foreign bodies and has antioxidant properties. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Indian gooseberry ( Emblica officinalis ) 
 Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula ) 
 Bibhitaki ( Terminalia bellirica ) 
 Turmeric ( Curcuma longa ) 
 Daruhaldi ( Berberis aristata ) 
 Badi Kateri ( Solanum indicum ) 
 Choti Kateri ( Solanum surattense ) 
 Kachura ( Curcuma zeodaria ) 
 Saunth ( Zingiber officinalis ) 
 Black pepper ( Piper nigrum )

 Method of Preparation 
 Grind all the ingredients separately to make a fine powder and combine them. Store them in an airtight container away from heat, light and moisture. 
 Dosage 
 3 to 6 grams twice a day with hot water. 
 Indications 
 
 Malaria 
 Typhoid fever 
 Loss of appetite 
 Chronic fevers 
 Acute fevers 
 Headache 
 Fever related to spleen & liver problems 
 Bodyache 
 Cough & cold 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 There are no known adverse effects of this formulation. 
 Over dosage is strictly discouraged. 
 It should be taken under medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
